member.name: T:Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Storage.CacheContainer
member.summary: A temporary storage area on the console's utility (cache) partition, for downloaded data that can be recreated if lost, such as images or media segments. Use the inherited file methods to read and write files.
member.remarks: Only one cache container can be open at a time. Disposing it unmounts the partition. The container is not tied to a user profile; opening it with format set to erases its content, so treat it as a cache rather than a place for user data.
